frequency_question: How often does structural friction successfully block a Senate confirmation within a 15-day window?
membership_rule: Includes cabinet and major agency head nominations submitted or pending floor action with active procedural opposition or tight calendar constraints; excludes routine un-contested en-bloc confirmations.

cases.name: Nomination of Kavita Patel (CMS - analog health)

provenance_note: claimed 2 hits but 3 of 5 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 5 instances explicitly detailed; represents a subset of fast-track contested health nominations.

skeleton: Total high-friction health agency nominations considered under a 15-day or shorter remaining legislative clock divided by those successfully blocked.
multiplier: 2 blocked out of 5 observed structural friction instances in compressed windows
